item.title: Data Protection Board appointments: update
item.description:
Not a case: the regulator under the DPDP Act (Union Government)

The question: When the Data Protection Board's Chairperson and Members will be appointed.

Where it stands: The Board was established in law on 13 November 2025, but no Chairperson or Member had been appointed as of mid-November 2026, even as consent manager registration opened on 13 November. The Kerala High Court recorded on 7 October that the Board was not functional.
